up: Return the ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES for all unique compounds tested against the target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1293258. Output exactly two columns: compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Do not apply row limits or extra filters.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assays a ON td.tid = a.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293258'
